scope: Verification of zero network requirement for user persistence and active trip operations

invariants.zero_cloud_sync: No account login, Firebase, Supabase, CloudKit, or remote sync endpoints invoked
invariants.pure_local_sqlite: Android uses Room SQLite in app-private storage; iOS uses SwiftData in application support
invariants.offline_trip_progression: Mark Visited, Skip Stop, and End Trip function 100% offline in airplane mode
invariants.offline_itinerary_review: Persisted trips, stops, and AI notes display completely without active internet connectivity
invariants.offline_saved_places: Saved places list and cached display snapshots load with zero network requests
